book.name: Luk
book.title: Luk Yesu Ye Weng Amun Lukbed Wongkoon

content: Sakius Anam Andoon
Kwane, Yesu kuu Yeriko siti aom aomdere wonoon. Kwane, dangkoro deweneen.
Yeriko aom kuu karub maa yaningko Sakius. Ye kuu yiribman yemooniib, kwane tak od bidan yi korok.
Ye dowaken kuu Yesu kuu wedmenande kamoon, kumban ye kuu dukmen kowe, kadaareb yi korok ari kuu burudande wedmindeban.
Kwanoone, yembed yekaad, Yesu kuu kuyaa mene yaadaraneen andekore, yedin kabaanmo wene at yaningko sikamoo arimbed daane Yesu wedmenande daanoon.
Kwane, Yesu kuu wene kuyaa nandekore, kankoone wedmoone Sakius kuu at ari kowe, Yesumbed yedmenoon, “Sakius, kirod kamene! Kibikee ne kuu eb ambiwoom dobaraniin kowe.” andoon.
Kwanandoone, Sakius kirod kamenene Yesu yaa kubenoon.
Kwanoone, nimakarub kuu wedmekorib kongeniwen, “Wedmime, karub kane arebkob Yesu yoom dobiriib. Sakius kuu ambarakmi ye karub kuda!” ande kamiwen.

Kumban Sakiusbed Yariman yaa yedmoon, “Yariman, wedme. Ne yiribman kuu andokbe angkara kuu kamboknondan yaa bangkandaniin. Kwane, nembed karub kane yaa biranaan kuu ye yaa birani ye kakman nongkobe kaningiib inendaniin.” andoon.
Kwanandoone, Yesumbed yedmoon, “Kibikee, anam andoonkob Godbed bobni yaa kuu burudande nendoon kii, amborom kuu karub kee Abraham areb anam andoon kowe.
“Kwane, Karub Ye Mingki kuu mene bikderebe winiwendan kuu onme wedmene bobni yaa kuu burudande bindi dowad monoon.” andoon.
Demedan Od Ooniwen Ye Kuruweng

Yesu kuu Yerusalem dia doroon kowe, nimakarub yenambed meeniwen kuu Godbed korok kere ooni yeman kuu kirod kerandamuun manok andiwen. Kwane, Yesu kuu yekaadkeroon, nimakarub kuu kwane meeniwen kowe, yembed kuruweng kee yi yaa dakmoon,

“Korok darewoob kuu ye ambibkindan korem yi king kerandamoon kowe, wenene ambibkin yemoon oonoon ye king darewoobbed ne yaa kinok ande wonoon. ‘Kwanekori, ika mene ne nimakarub yaa oona.’ ande meenoon.
Kowe, yembed ye deme karub angko angkoyiib yaa baandoone, mimyamo keriwen. Kwaniiwe, yembed mimim kuu od murubkob aningko mina
mimim bangkandekore yedmendoon, ‘Od kee bewene ari deme ambangkibko ika mana.’ andoon. Andekore wonoon.

“Kumban ye ambibkindan yena kuu ye yaa dowakenban keruniwen kowe, yimbed karub yena yedmiiwe ye yoman wene king darewoob yaa yedmiwen, ‘ “Karub kee nub korok keri kuu nub dowakenban.” ande yedmiib kii.’ andiwen.

Kumban king darewoob kinoona, karub kuu ye ambibkindan yi king keroon. “Kwanekore, ika monoon kuu yembed yedmoon, ‘Karub kane kane ne od be wenebiwen kuu baandibko menebime. Ne dowaken kuu ambangkiwen kuu ari komoyiib biwen kuyaa kaadkerandamiin.’ andoon.
“Kwanandoone, deme karub ibduruk kuu mene yedmoon, ‘Korok ee, ne kuu od mina mimo kawewen kuu ambangkeni ari od mina angko angkoyiib baan kii!’ andoon.
“Kwanandoone, kingbed ye deme karub yaa yedmoon, ‘Yimin kerewen, eb kuu ne deme karub amun kii, amborom kuu eb kuu barang embengiib ongme ambangkewen kowe, siti angko angkoyiib ebbed oone.’ andoon.
“Kwanandoone, deme karub mamaambed mene yedmoon, ‘Korok ee, eb od mina mimo kawewen kuu ambangkeni ari od mina angkoyiib baan kii!’ andoon.
“Kwanandoone, kingbed yedmoon, ‘Eb kuu siti angkoyiib oone.’ andoon.
“Kwane, deme karub maa kuu mene yedmoon, ‘Korok ee, eb od mina kuu kei. Ebkad baradbed bedmekori kankowe biknaan.
Ne kuu eb yaa unaan, amborom kuu eb kuu yobdood ye karub kowe. Ebka ari ma ambangkindo ye od bimaab, kwane ebka kibinindo ye animan be wenorimaab kowe.’ andoon.

“Kwanandoone, kingbed ye deme karub yaa inande yedmoon, ‘Eb kuu deme karub arewa! Ebka eb weng dakmewen kumbed kwane wengyunda. Ebbed yedmeeb kuu ne kuu yobdood ye karub. Kwane yedmeeb kuu neka ari ma ambangkindo ye od beni, neka kibinindo ye animan wenorimainoo?
Anam kwana karen kuu ne od kuu kanwene od beng aom kowewedka. Kwane, ne ika manaan kuu ne od kuu ariyiib kan dabokniwedned.’ andoon.
“Andekore, kingbed demedan yena yaa yedmoon, ‘Karub keyaa od mina kee nan angkaro deme karub maa ambangkene od mina angko angkoyiib boon ye karub yaa nonime!’ andoon.
“Kumban yimbed yedmiwen, ‘Korok ee, karub kee ye kuu od mina angko angkoyiib keroon kii!’ andiwen.

“Kwanandiiwe, kingbed yedmoon, ‘Kanembed ye yaa angkeen kuu ongme awinaneen kuu ari yemoon ye yaa bangkananeen. Kumban kanembed ye yaa angkeen kuu awinindo keroon kuu ye yaa korem kuu beene dowan keraneen.
Karub kane kane ne yaa king keraan ande bon keriwendan kuu kuna? Keyaa be mene ne arinambo arimbed yenib nongkobime.’” andoon.
Kubi Darewoowiib Yerusalem Aom Awuniwen
Yesu kuu kwane dakme dowan kerekore, yedin wene Yerusalem yaa nandok wonoon.
Kwane, Yesu kuu mene aangko Olif dia kambong Betfegiib Betaniyiib yaa nandoon. Kwanekore, ye kedmengkandeendan ayoob yaa yedmoon,
“Wene kambong kuyaa awune wedmaniiwe, donki ingkod kuu kuyaa boroniwen kii. Donki kwari kuu karub maa, ma kwari dibere yarebindo. Wedme dudberekorib, keyaa kanminime.
Karub kanembed yiib yaa ‘Komo dowad dudbarandiwed?’ andoka yedmenime, ‘Yarimanbed ye deme yaa kankowanded.’ andime.” andoon.
Kwanandoone, ye kedmengkandeendan ayoob kuu kambong aom winiwen. Kwane, wene wedmiwen kuu donki kuu Yesumbed dakmoon arebmo.
Kowe, kwane nong kuu dudmungkaiwe, kangkodanbed yi yaa kaamondiwen, “Yiib kuu komandiwed donki kuu kwane dudmungkaib?” andiwen.
Kwanandiiwe, yimbed inandiwen, “Yarimanbed ye deme yaa kankowanded.” andiwen.
Kwane, Yesuyiib yaa kanminiiwe, ye kedmengkandeendan yi yuruk ebkad kuu biangke ben donki ye angkurom ari nongkobekorib, Yesu kuu kwari nenkowiiwe diboroon.
Kwane, Yesu kuu Yerusalem yaa wene doroone, nimakarub kuu yi yuruk ebkad kuu biangke ben kiwaan yiri ye arinambo ari kudmenmo winiwen.

Kwane, wene ye kuu mene aangko Olif kankoonimbon dia menene aangko dabon yiri Yerusalem nandi ye kiwaan wanandamoon. Kwane, kadaareb ye yoman winimaibdan kuu God yaa kube baande kankooniwen, amborom kuu God yaromkono wedmi yeman yemoon ongmenaboon kuu wedmiwen kowe.
Kwane, kubenenib yedmiwen,

content.text: “King kee Yariman yaambed ke meneen kee amun kerunok!
Ewen ari kuu yewenubmo kere God yaa kuu nambirimo kerundok!” ande kamiwen.

content: Kwane, Farisidan yenambed nimakarub wedangkambed Yesu yaa yedmiwen, “Kedmengkandi korok! Eb kedmengkandeebdan kuu yedmende kwane dakmaib!” andiwen.
Kumban Yesumbed inandoon, “Iwari keraniib kuu botbed ne yaa kubi weng komkaniib.” andoon.
Yesu Kuu Yerusalem Yu Dowad Ameng Kamoon
Kwane, Yesu kuu Yerusalem dia menene, siti kuu wedmekore yu dowad ameng kamoon.
Kwane, yembed Yerusalem yaa yedmoon, “Kub dore God dore yewenub yeman kub yaa kibik meneen kumban, kubkaadkerindo kowe kub yaa biknoon.
Aron kuu mananuun kwane kub bondanbed kub kuuk dungkun ari damkamenmo daani yeman ongmenib, kub yaa dewene awanewandenib, yiriyiib ariyiib kebed angkayiib kwane awinebdaniib.

Kwane, yimbed kub yoom kub nimakarub yoom dana yoom kub kuuk aom kuu okad yiri benkiradme monmaraniib. Ku yenbewen ye bot kuu korem benkiradmenib ma korondaiwe mamaa yaa dabokne angkimbaraanban. Korem kamaneen kee amborom kuu Godbed kub yaa monoon yaron kuu kub wedmewen kumban kubkaadban kerewen kowe.” andoon.
Yesu Kurikuri Boyambib Darewoob Yaa Wonoon
Kwanandekore, kurikuri boyambib darewoob yaa wonoon. Kwane, yembed karuwa nimaya barang kuyaom berengkanabiib kuu andowe ben kiradmoon.
Kwanekore yedmoon, “God Ye Weng yaa wongkoon kuu, ‘Ne kurikuri boyambib darewoob kuu kurikuri yambib keranuun.’ kumban yiibbed ‘yid bimaibdan yi ambib’ areb keriwen kii!” andoon.

Kwane, Yesu kuu kurikuri boyambib darewoob yaambed aron korem kedmengkandemboroon. Kumban God dore Yuudan dore wedyiri dobiridan yi korok korokiib Yuudan yi amob kedmengkandidaniib korok korok yenayiibbed Yesu ayande kamiwen.
Kuned yembed dakmeene wengambiriibdan kuu ye yaa dowaken keruniwen kowe, ongme wengaomiib doriib. Kwani kowe, korok korok kuu ayanuub andi ye kiwaan wedmindo.
